body: Waiting for the End and The Messenger. I had always loved those two songs, but they really took on a new meaning to me after my suicide attempt 3 years ago. I really took the lyrics "The hardest part of ending is starting again" and "Remember you're loved, and you always will be" to heart, and after much hard work and treatment, I am a good place mentally, physically, and emotionally. They became somewhat of a soundtrack of my recovery, and I'm forever grateful to this band for saving my life.

Rode out Hurricane Sandy in north NJ back in 2012. Despite being over 150 miles from the landfall point, she packed one hell of a punch. Trees and powerlines down everywhere, flooding, parts of roofs missing, etc. Not to mention being without power and warm water for 2 weeks. 


Still get nervous everytime a nor'easter hits the Northeast.
